strategic_bet: TARGETED — Wed Jun 10 AM. Dilruba's two proven lanes (Morning Energy 155K, Clear-Your-Mind 77K/32.2% AVD) are BOTH owned, so any fresh lead is an audition. We avoid reusing 'Morning Energy' (cannibalization) and the failed synonyms (Good Energy 19.8% AVD, Uplifting 1.3K, Vitality 31). Two fresh leads tested head-to-head; Raga Yaman kept (empirically delivered 29.3% AVD AM despite generic 'evening' theory). Also diversifies week title structure away from 'Morning ___ Music' monotony (Sunrise variant).
failure_mode: <2500 views or <3.8% CTR by day 7 — fresh leads lack resonance; signal that Dilruba morning only works with 'Morning Energy + Yaman' and the slot should switch instruments next time.
